source: Ruijie Networks results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)

players.product: 400G/800G data-center Ethernet switches for AI computing clusters (128-port 800G box switch; 51.2T CPO co-packaged switch solution), plus 1.6T/800G optical modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Ruan Jiayong (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): with leading domestic cloud providers' large capex plans driving demand for AI-computing data-center switches, the revenue share of the company's 400G and 800G high-speed data-center switches has risen sharply since 2025, and he expects that growth trend to continue in 2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO and vice president Liu Hongyu (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): the company's own 400G/800G optical modules are sold to internet companies with high-performance computing network needs, matched to the data-center switches and solutions they buy from it; 400G LPO optical modules are in volume production and delivery, 800G optical modules are at the small-scale prototype adaptation stage, and a 1.6T LPO product is in development with samples expected within 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 400G LPO in volume delivery; 800G at prototype adaptation; 1.6T LPO samples expected in 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Ruan Jiayong on the sharp rise in Q1 2026 prepayments (results briefing): with ample orders on hand in Q1 the company stepped up raw-material purchasing and stocking to deliver on time; international chip supply has stayed tight and upstream core-chip makers generally require prepayment to lock in capacity and supply, so the company raised prepayments to lock in core capacity (especially chips) in line with its production plans.
